Blocker-closure continuation — executing registered studies

This continuation adds a genuinely optimal finite-state regenerative Bellman/QVI oracle, a labeled evidence task with reset continuation, matched-information boundary/channel controls, fresh-actor audiovisual encoders, and a source-bound trained-state/native-execution bridge.

- **Finite oracle:** 193/193 mathematical checks; 7/7 Torch gradient/optimization checks. Independent LP and expanded hidden-label CTMC agree with the policy solution. A strong ordinary two-threshold policy exactly ties the task optimum; no architecture advantage is inferred.
- **Actual native task runtime:** 160 processes, 640 STOP/reset cycles, 5,535 native decisions. All raw records are retained in the bounded `artifacts/runtime_local001` archive. Whole-worker CPU is measured separately from nested child clocks.
- **Content study:** 444 registered jobs on fresh paired seeds, source seal `c9063043d088b6b469e740b9b6f341f3faea3928`; [run 41156755829](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/41156755829) is training. This includes 19 arms, the full 3-boundary × 2-feature control and separate fixed/equal-training-CPU regimes.
- **Audiovisual study:** 90 registered jobs, source seal `6469cc94a72aed214c5c9d2ff2fba14cdb146626`; [run 41158089224](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/41158089224) is training after successful provenance/runtime preflight. The 720 clips use 30 entirely fresh actors, disjoint train/validation/test actors, actual elapsed time, five matched models and actor × seed uncertainty.
- **Training-to-runtime bridge:** preselected Copy/JG/seed 881101, with explicit source/protocol/checkpoint pins. Synthetic source review is complete (18/18); real checkpoint execution awaits the sealed run's evidence. The original import failure and scoped repair are retained.
- Independent result auditors, hardware capability/latency/actual-energy measurement contracts and raw archive restoration checks are retained under `experiments/hcsn_blocker_closure_v1/`.

**No result from the two running studies is claimed yet.** Their integrity gates are separate from scientific benefit gates. Existing negative results, the coarse-grid suboptimality counterexample and all original acceptance thresholds remain unchanged. CUDA/Joules and foundation-model scale are unvalidated. This PR remains draft and **SHADOW_ONLY / DENY_ALL / NO_GO**; inherited broad CI failures are not replaced by a successful research workflow.

## Previously completed acceleration study

## Problem and change

The distributional HCSN's finite probability/event operator imposed substantial CPU overhead. This PR evaluates the same registered degree-21 augmented Poisson polynomial with positive-coefficient Paterson–Stockmeyer blocks, integrates the already-declared conservative probability profile into both model backends, and connects trained persistent neural state to the real pinned Rust owner. No fitted parameter, physical generator, reset/refractory rule, task objective or frozen acceptance threshold is changed between the reference/accelerated pair.

**The completed result is a faithful internal implementation improvement; architecture superiority remains unproven.** All 70 hosted jobs are valid. Six primary fixed-update pairs give **1.9875× training CPU** and **1.7430× whole-worker CPU** geometric-mean speedups with equal selected accuracies. **0/18 external quality-conditioned comparisons qualify.**

## Actual content results

Approximately 30 training CPU seconds per run, three paired seeds, mean ± sample SD:

| Model | Selective copy | MQAR |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| HCSN reference | 21.55% ± 2.15pp | 16.60% ± 3.41pp |
| HCSN accelerated | 35.29% ± 0.88pp | 33.50% ± 1.45pp |
| Ordinary two gates | 99.06% ± 0.79pp | 19.73% ± 11.16pp |
| Transformer | 44.73% ± 1.22pp | 100.00% ± 0.00pp |
| LIF control | 13.57% ± 0.70pp | 12.89% ± 1.67pp |

The common learning rate and short CPU budget are not tuned architecture optima. Seven jobs in the earlier aborted local cohort had already evaluated this heldout split, so the full hosted rerun is an **engineering replication**, not fresh-test confirmation. Old runs were not pooled or used to fill the new 70-job cohort. CREMA-D is a single-seed, 16-update, fixed-feature descriptive supplement: HCSN 17.50%, Transformer 20.83%, two gates/LIF 16.67%.

## Six-stage acceptance status

| Stage | Evidence and boundary |
| --- | --- |
| Event contract | C/P/F/f/H/K, conditioning, time, initial atoms, repeated events, reset and refractory semantics fixed. C/P are count/probability, not literal option prices. |
| Oracle | Scalar regenerative QVI includes post-fire continuation; numerical/implicit-gradient checks pass. The Brownian boundary is not certified optimal on the finite reflecting grid or for classification; sampled finite-grid counterexamples remain. |
| Joint learning | Content, dynamics, boundary pathway, reset and refractory groups receive finite gradients and actual updates. Complete component-freeze causal benefit remains unfinished. |
| Mechanism attribution | Prior mechanism gates remain 0/6 and 0/4; no new positive boundary/dual-channel net-benefit claim. |
| Content and modalities | Copy/MQAR and real AV outcomes retained, including failures. No general encoder, time-extrapolation or foundation-model advantage. |
| Hepta and hardware | Real KEEP/STOP, persistence, trained-state intervention and CPU acceleration verified. Neural computation remains Python/PyTorch; GPU/native neural kernel, direct joules and foundation-scale evidence are absent. |

## Verification and complete evidence

- 17 forward cases, 9 physical-parameter gradient directions, 8 invalid-input guards and 4,096-step float32 flow retain their frozen tolerances.
- Train-only paired preflight: three tasks × three updates; all five parameter groups change.
- Six primary fixed-update pairs: maximum loss-trajectory difference 2.3842e-7; maximum final parameter difference 2.9579e-6.
- Trained stream restoration: B=2, T=128, cut=37, new interpreter; suffix logits/final state bitwise equal. The 968-byte figure covers persistent numeric neural state only.
- Seven actual native owner processes: KEEP×5→STOP and four continuous-message interventions. Value-to-message calibration is explicit; this is causal execution evidence, not task-optimal stopping.
- Independent math/source, statistical/cost, and runtime reviews, plus full local byte restoration and frozen-analyzer replay. All 145 archive parts and 1,289 members match their hashes. Every analysis field matches except the replay analyzer's own CPU/wall times; REPORT.md is byte-identical.
- Preserve the failed first hosted bootstrap, the earlier local aborted cohort (7 successful/2 failed/61 unstarted), complete Actions logs, all checkpoints/logits/receipts and old negative mechanism outcomes. No relaxed tolerance or retrospective success relabeling.

Measured hosted prepare/train/finalize CPU totals 1,450.629780 seconds; measured packaging adds 33.374690, for a measured subset of 1,484.004470 CPU seconds. The nested 1,408.708157 worker CPU and 1,089.402744 training CPU must not be added again. Development, installation and publisher CPU are not fully measured. No joules are inferred from expected event counts.

## CI preservation repair

The repository spelling job reported 3,563 diagnostics from immutable XZ/Base64 payload bytes and one from a verbatim upstream README; new source/reports had none. A narrow path/type exclusion preserves those exact payloads while continuing to check source, prose and manifests. No workflow or ignored-word list changed. The [scope receipt](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/1d959d8d82091e6014b13c2191f62bf74e778561/experiments/hcsn_conservative_acceleration_v1/reports/CI_EVIDENCE_SPELLING_SCOPE.json) covers all 665 observed paths and six negative controls. The two new reports also use GitHub-compatible math delimiters. Codespell, blob-size and the retried scope selection have passed. The first scope checkout exhausted its existing five-minute limit; a single-job retry succeeded without changing the workflow or gate. The broader ordinary PR CI is still running, separately from the already-successful 70-job research workflow.
